notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Elemental.
The Elemental dies, triggering Galvanic Juggernaut, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
